[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Gandara, the Moon Fortress view.jpg|200px]] | pic2-text = A view of the fortress | pic3 = [[File:"Crescent Island" concept art.jpg|200px]] | pic3-text = Concept art by [[Daniel Dociu]] | pic4 = [[File:Gandara, the Moon Fortress prison.jpg|200px]] | pic4-text = The Gandaran prison | ingame name=Gandara, the Moon Fortress | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=381 }} [[Gandara, the Moon Fortress]], dominates the south coast of [[Kourna]], surrounded by the Elon river. In this [[explorable area]], characters cannot actually enter the fortress proper. Only the outskirts of the fortress are accessible. To enter the fortress, characters will need to start the [[Pogahn Passage]] mission. ==Getting there== The only way to get here is via the [[Pogahn Passage (outpost)|Pogahn Passage outpost]]. The latter part of the [[primary quest]] [[No Me, No Kormir]] will point characters a short distance into this area. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Wandering
